jp: 旅行[りょこう]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}ガイド{に|causative-passive}朝[あさ]五時[ごじ]{に|ni-time}出発[しゅっぱつ]させられました。
en: On the trip, the guide made me set off at five in the morning.
why: The person who forces the action is marked with に in the causative-passive; を would mark an object, not the one who makes me do it.

jp: 観光[かんこう]バス{の|no-possessive}中[なか]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}幹事[かんじ]{に|causative-passive}自己紹介[じこしょうかい]{を|o-object}させられました。
en: On the tour bus, the organizer made me introduce myself.
why: The organizer is the one who made me do it, so he takes に; を is already used for the thing I was made to do.

jp: 空港[くうこう]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}係員[かかりいん]{に|causative-passive}荷物[にもつ]{を|o-object}全部[ぜんぶ]開[あ]けさせられました。
en: At the airport, a staff member made me open all of my luggage.
why: The staff member forced me to open it, so the causer takes に in the causative-passive.

jp: 修学旅行[しゅうがくりょこう]{で|de-place}、生徒[せいと]たち{は|wa-topic}先生[せんせい]{に|causative-passive}京都[きょうと]{の|no-possessive}町[まち]{を|o-path}一日中[いちにちじゅう]歩[ある]かされました。
en: On the school trip, the teacher made the students walk around Kyoto all day.
why: The teacher made them walk, so he is marked with に; を here belongs to the route walked through.

jp: 出張[しゅっちょう]{の|no-possessive}前日[ぜんじつ]、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}部長[ぶちょう]{に|causative-passive}切符[きっぷ]{を|o-object}三回[さんかい]買[か]い直[なお]させられました。
en: The day before the business trip, my boss made me rebuy the tickets three times.
why: The boss is the one who made me redo it, so he takes に in the causative-passive.

jp: 弟[おとうと]{は|wa-topic}兄[あに]{に|causative-passive}重[おも]いスーツケース{を|o-object}駅[えき]{まで|made-until}運[はこ]ばされました。
en: Our older brother made my younger brother carry a heavy suitcase to the station.
why: The older brother is the causer, so he is marked with に; the suitcase he had to carry keeps を.

jp: 人気[にんき]{の|no-possessive}店[みせ]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}友達[ともだち]{に|causative-passive}二時間[にじかん]並[なら]ばされました。
en: At the popular shop, my friend made me queue for two hours.
why: The friend made me queue, so the friend is marked with に in the causative-passive.

jp: 初[はじ]めて{の|no-possessive}海外旅行[かいがいりょこう]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}現地[げんち]{の|no-possessive}友達[ともだち]{に|causative-passive}変[へん]な味[あじ]{の|no-possessive}お茶[ちゃ]{を|o-object}飲[の]まされました。
en: On my first trip abroad, a local friend made me drink some oddly flavoured tea.
why: The local friend pressed the tea on me, so that person takes に; the tea I was made to drink keeps を.

jp: 家族旅行[かぞくりょこう]{で|de-place}、私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}父[ちち]{に|causative-passive}朝早[あさはや]く山[やま]{を|o-path}登[のぼ]らされました。
en: On the family trip, my father made me climb the mountain early in the morning.
why: The father is the one who made me climb, so he takes に; the mountain climbed is the path marked with を.

jp: 去年[きょねん]、父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}会社[かいしゃ]{に|causative-passive}遠[とお]い町[まち]{に/へ|ni-destination}転勤[てんきん]させられました。
en: Last year my father's company made him transfer to a distant town.
why: The company is the one who forced the transfer, so it is marked with に in the causative-passive.

jp: 観光地[かんこうち]{で|de-place}、母[はは]{は|wa-topic}ガイド{に|causative-passive}長[なが]い説明[せつめい]{を|o-object}聞[き]かされました。
en: At the tourist spot, the guide made my mother sit through a long explanation.
why: The guide forced the long explanation on her, so the guide takes に in the causative-passive.

jp: 終電[しゅうでん]{を|o-object}逃[のが]した友達[ともだち]{に|causative-passive}、駅[えき]{まで|made-until}車[くるま]{で|de-means}迎[むか]え{に|ni-purpose}行[い]かされました。
en: My friend who missed the last train made me drive to the station to pick them up.
why: The friend is the one who made me go, so the friend takes に in the causative-passive 行かされる.
